text_en: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming near to listen to him.
text_cn: 众税吏及罪人们都来接近耶稣，为听他讲道。

text_en: And the Pharisees and the scribes were grumbling and saying, “This fellow welcomes sinners and eats with them. ”
text_cn: 法利塞人及经师们窃窃私议说：“这个人交接罪人，又同他们吃饭。”

text_en: So he told them this parable:
text_cn: 耶稣遂对他们设了这个比喻说：

text_en: “Which one of you, having a hundred sheep and losing one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that is lost until he finds it?
text_cn: “你们中间哪个人有一百只羊，遗失了其中的一只，而不把这九十九只丢在荒野，去寻觅那遗失的一只，直到找着呢？

text_en: When he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders and rejoices.
text_cn: 待找着了，就喜欢的把它放在自己的肩膀上，

text_en: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep that was lost. ’
text_cn: 来到家中，请他的友好及邻人来，给他们说：你们与我同乐罢！因为我那只遗失了的羊，又找到了。

text_en: Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：同样，对于一个罪人悔改，在天上所有的欢乐，甚于对那九十九个无须悔改的义人。”

text_en: “Or what woman having ten silver coins, if she loses one of them, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?
text_cn: “或者哪个妇女，有十个‘达玛’，若遗失了一个‘达玛’， 而不点上灯，打扫房屋，细心寻找，直到找着呢？

text_en: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin that I had lost. ’
text_cn: 待找着了，她就请女友及邻人来说：你们与我同乐罢！因为我失去的那个‘达玛’又找到了。

text_en: Just so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：对于一个罪人悔改，在天主的使者前，也是这样欢乐。”

text_en: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
text_cn: 耶稣又说：“一个人有两个儿子，

text_en: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me the share of the property that will belong to me. ’ So he divided his property between them.
text_cn: 那小的向父亲说：父亲，请把我应得的一分家产给我罢！父亲遂把产业给他们分开了。

text_en: A few days later the younger son gathered all he had and traveled to a distant country, and there he squandered his property in dissolute living.
text_cn: 过了不多几天，小儿子把所有的一切都收拾起来，就往远方去了。他在那里荒淫度日，耗费他的资财。

text_en: When he had spent everything, a severe famine took place throughout that country, and he began to be in need.
text_cn: 当他把所有的都挥霍尽了以后，那地方正遇着大荒年，他便开始穷困起来。

text_en: So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed the pigs.
text_cn: 他去投靠一个当地的居民；那人打发他到自己的庄田上去放猪。

text_en: He would gladly have filled himself with the pods that the pigs were eating; and no one gave him anything.
text_cn: 他恨不能拿猪吃的豆荚来果腹，可是没有人给他。

text_en: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many of my father’s hired hands have bread enough and to spare, but here I am dying of hunger!
text_cn: 他反躬自问：我父亲有多少佣工，都口粮丰盛，我在这里反要饿死！

text_en: I will get up and go to my father, and I will say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you;
text_cn: 我要起身到我父亲那里去，并且要给他说：父亲！我得罪了天，也得罪了你。

text_en: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; treat me like one of your hired hands. ”’
text_cn: 我不配再称作你的儿子，把我当作你的一个佣工罢！

text_en: So he set off and went to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion; he ran and put his arms around him and kissed him.
text_cn: 他便起身到他父亲那里去了。他离的还远的时候，他父亲就看见了他，动了怜悯的心，跑上前去，扑到他的脖子上，热情地亲吻他。

text_en: Then the son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you; I am no longer worthy to be called your son. ’
text_cn: 儿子向他说：父亲，我得罪了天，也得罪了你，我不配再称作你的儿子了！

text_en: But the father said to his slaves, ‘Quickly, bring out a robe—the best one—and put it on him; put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
text_cn: 父亲却吩咐自己的仆人说：你们快拿出上等的袍子来给他穿上，把戒指戴在他手上，给他脚上穿上鞋，

text_en: And get the fatted calf and kill it, and let us eat and celebrate;
text_cn: 再把那只肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们应吃喝欢宴，

text_en: for this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found! ’ And they began to celebrate.
text_cn: 因为我这个儿子是死而复生，失而复得了；他们就欢宴起来。

text_en: “Now his elder son was in the field; and when he came and approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
text_cn: 那时，他的长子正在田地里，当他回来快到家的时候，听见有奏乐及歌舞的欢声，

text_en: He called one of the slaves and asked what was going on.
text_cn: 遂叫一个仆人过来，问他这是什么事。

text_en: He replied, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has got him back safe and sound. ’
text_cn: 仆人向他说：你弟弟回来了，你父亲因为见他无恙归来，便为他宰了那只肥牛犊。

text_en: Then he became angry and refused to go in. His father came out and began to plead with him.
text_cn: 长子就生气不肯进去，他父亲遂出来劝解他。

text_en: But he answered his father, ‘Listen! For all these years I have been working like a slave for you, and I have never disobeyed your command; yet you have never given me even a young goat so that I might celebrate with my friends.
text_cn: 他回答父亲说：你看，这些年来我服事你，从未违背过你的命令，而你从未给过我一只小山羊，让我同我的朋友们欢宴；

text_en: But when this son of yours came back, who has devoured your property with prostitutes, you killed the fatted calf for him! ’
text_cn: 但你这个儿子同娼妓们耗尽了你的财产，他一回来，你倒为他宰了那只肥牛犊。

text_en: Then the father said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
text_cn: 父亲给他说：孩子！你常同我在一起，凡我所有的，都是你的；

text_en: But we had to celebrate and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and has come to life; he was lost and has been found. ’”
text_cn: 只因为你这个弟弟死而复生，失而复得，应当欢宴喜乐！”
